package.name: cjw_multisite_democontent
package.description: The content of the CJW Multisite starter site (design starter of the cjw_themes_jumper extension): pages, articles, news, galleries, banners, forms and images, in English and German, with the content classes it uses. The image and file contents are read from extension/cjw_themes_jumper/share/content-images and content-files.
